landing_text: How to found a $(l)town$(), plan and grow it into a $(#d4a838)capital$(), research, forge equipment, raise and command an $(#e8642a)army$(), and win wars between kingdoms.$(br2)Open your City Manager with $(k:livingrealms.open), or use your Town Charter. $(l)Shift + right-click$() one of your recruits to command it.
